name: Influx Healthtech Ltd
tagline: Debt-free, 40%-ROCE nutraceutical CDMO that delivered ~40% FY26 growth as guided, but has cut FY27 growth guidance to 25-30%, and cash conversion / working capital deteriorated sharply this year
business_overview: Influx Healthtech (founded 2020) is a contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) for nutraceuticals, cosmetics, ayurvedic/herbal, petcare, veterinary feed supplements, and homecare products, serving 600+ B2B customers. Listed on NSE Emerge (SME board) in June 2025 via a Rs 48 Cr IPO, majority fresh issue.
fundamentals_table: Rs 76 Cr (FY23) -> Rs 100 Cr (FY24) -> Rs 105 Cr (FY25) -> Rs 147 Cr (FY26, +40% YoY, in line with guidance)
Rs 29.9 Cr / 20.3% FY26 (H1 22%, H2 ~19% - some give-back)
FY26 CFO only ~Rs 4 Cr (~41% of operating profit); FCF ~ -Rs 21 Cr on capex; working-capital days rose to ~83 (FY26) vs ~48 (FY25)
Debt-free (D/E ~0); no promoter pledge; promoter holding 73.53% (unchanged)
fundamentals_narrative: Returns on capital stay exceptional for the size — ~40% ROCE, ~45% ROE, debt-free, promoter 73.53% with no pledge. FY26 revenue Rs 147 Cr (+40% YoY) landed in line with management guidance; EBITDA Rs 29.9 Cr at 20.3% margin (+45% YoY), PAT Rs 20.5 Cr (+54%). Two things the earlier write-up did not capture, though: (1) cash quality weakened materially this year — FY26 CFO was only ~Rs 4 Cr, ~41% of operating profit, FCF about -Rs 21 Cr, and the working-capital cycle stretched to ~83 days from ~48; and (2) the growth runway has been marked down — a 10-Jul-2026 Q1 FY27 update guides FY27 revenue growth of just 25-30%, versus earlier 'more than double the business by FY27' commentary. The Rs ~45 Cr IPO proceeds plus a further ~Rs 10 Cr are being deployed into an automated beverage line (10,000 bph), a pet-food line (1,000 kg/hr), retort systems and packaging, with commissioning targeted for H1 FY27 — so the next growth leg now clearly needs the new capacity, not just utilisation of the old.
technical_read: Not independently pulled — stock recently listed (June 2025), narrow 52-week range so far.
sentiment_summary: Read the entire thread (15 posts, single batch, Aug 2025-Aug 2026, no escalation needed). Consistently positive, fact-based tracking rather than hype — plant-visit attendance, concall summaries, and cross-checking of a speculative-investor rumor.
community_signal: Trusted-roster user Satishwe authored the opening thesis post and has been the dominant, most-engaged tracker (81 loves across 8 posts) — extensive, detailed, ongoing engagement, though none of the individual posts state an explicit position size or 'core holding' language, so no formal high-conviction entry was logged (informational tracking, not a stated conviction call). raj1968 (13 loves) posted detailed H1FY26 concall notes. Community proactively investigated and debunked a rumor that a known SME-scrip-flipping investor ('Rohan Gupta') had taken a stake, confirming it was a name coincidence unrelated to the well-known investor of that name — good due-diligence hygiene by the thread.
bse_notes: FY26 annual report filed 26-Aug-2026; 6th AGM 18-Sep-2026. FY26 earnings call held 22-May-2026. Palghar FSSAI-licensed facility commenced 14-Oct-2025 (adds tablet capacity); a multi-line facility (tablet/liquid/sachet/capsule) was commercialised via ~Rs 2.8 Cr internal accruals. 10-Jul-2026 Q1 FY27 business update: ~Rs 10 Cr additional capacity expansion, ~2.5x manufacturing uplift, FY27 revenue-growth guidance 25-30%. Received a GMP inspection-compliance confirmation from the Tanzania Bureau of Standards (Mar 2026); exports still a very small share of revenue.
bull_case: Still an exceptional returns profile for the size — ~40% ROCE, ~45% ROE, debt-free, promoter 73.53% with zero pledge
FY26 delivered ~40% revenue growth (Rs 147 Cr), +45% EBITDA and +54% PAT — in line with the guidance management had set, so execution credibility is intact

Concrete, funded capacity pipeline commissioning in H1 FY27: automated beverage line (10,000 bph), pet-food line (1,000 kg/hr), retort systems for protein shakes/RTD, plus the Palghar facility already live — a genuine step-change in addressable formats
Rs ~45 Cr of IPO proceeds still largely available for that expansion; long-range management ambition of Rs 450-500 Cr revenue by FY29
Diversified 600+ B2B customer base; a credible, heavily-engaged trusted community tracker (Satishwe) providing ongoing scrutiny
bear_case: FY27 growth guidance cut hard — the 10-Jul-2026 update guides 25-30% revenue growth for FY27 versus earlier 'more than double by FY27' commentary; the embedded 'double without capital' optionality thesis has weakened
Cash quality deteriorated this year: FY26 CFO only ~Rs 4 Cr (~41% of operating profit), FCF about -Rs 21 Cr, working-capital days up to ~83 from ~48 — a real watch-item for a stock at ~34x earnings
H2 FY26 EBITDA margin softened to ~19% from 22% in H1
SME-board (NSE Emerge) listing — structurally lower liquidity, lighter disclosure, higher pump/dump history; only listed June 2025, so limited public-company track record
Exports still under ~1% of revenue — growth is a single-market (domestic) concentration
Next growth leg now depends on the new lines actually commissioning on time in H1 FY27 rather than on utilising existing capacity
verdict_headline: Quality and execution credibility intact, but FY27 guidance was cut to 25-30% and cash conversion/working capital worsened this year - conviction eases to Medium-High
verdict_reasoning: The core attraction is undiminished: ~40% ROCE, debt-free, promoter-heavy with no pledge, and FY26 growth of ~40% delivered exactly as guided

But two findings this pass lower the conviction: (1) FY27 revenue-growth guidance of only 25-30% (down from 'more than double'), and (2) FY26 operating cash flow of just ~41% of operating profit with the working-capital cycle stretching to ~83 days - quality signals that matter at a ~34x multiple

Thesis-fit stays 10x-in-2-3-years but is now explicitly contingent: the beverage / pet-food / retort lines must commission on schedule in H1 FY27 and convert to revenue for the growth curve to re-steepen from the guided 25-30%
Net: conviction High -> Medium-High; still a high-quality small compounder, just no longer priced or guiding for the near-vertical trajectory the earlier note implied

deep_dive.conviction_update: High -> Medium-High. FY26 numbers confirm the quality and that guidance was met, but the FY27 growth guide of 25-30% (down from 'more than double'), weak FY26 cash conversion and a stretched working-capital cycle at a ~34x multiple together take the edge off the earlier near-vertical framing.

track_record.note: FY24-FY26 (company financials; screener 10y table login-gated this pass): debt-free ~40%-ROCE model so ROCE >=15% every year. Revenue Rs 76cr (FY23) -> 100 (+32%, FY24) -> 105 (+5%, FY25) -> 147 (+40%, FY26). Both metrics cleared FY24 and FY26 = 2 of 3; FY25 missed on the +5% flat year.

quality_metrics.note: Debt-free (D/E ~0; interest ~nil so coverage null), modest net cash from the IPO. roce_pct FY26 40% (ROE 45%, 3yr ROE 39%) -- high and stable. OPM ~20% (H1 22% / H2 19% give-back). Great returns, but FY26 cash conversion + a cut FY27 guide keep the read neutral.
